card.name: The word errors after Medication
card.fires_on: The word Errors (or its pieces ERR and ORS in capitals) right after Medication, as in the heading Risk of Medication Errors in drug labels.

modes.label: Title-case heading
modes.description: The word Errors after Medication in a label section title such as Risk of Medication Errors.
modes.example: use [see Dosage and Administration ( 2.5 )] . Risk of Medication<< Errors>> Accidental administration of neuromuscular

modes.label: All-caps heading
modes.description: The pieces ERR or ORS inside MEDICATION ERRORS in capitalized warning lists.
modes.example: ABUSE, AND MISUSE; LIFE-THREATENING RESPIRATORY DEPRESSION; ACCIDENTAL INGESTION; MEDICATION ERR<<ORS>>; CYTOCHROME P45

card.plain: It lights up on the phrase medication errors when it appears as a warning heading in a drug label.
